sections.p: This website is operated by Sivan Menahem Management, Plateia Eleftherias 2, 73132 Chania, Greece (the “controller”). Contact: support@sivanmanagment.com, +30 698 392 4820.

When you submit a form, we collect the details you provide: name, email, phone number, property information and your message. We also record technical data needed to protect the form against abuse, such as the time of submission and the page you came from. If you accept analytics, we collect anonymous, aggregated usage statistics.

We use your data to respond to your request, prepare a proposal and, if you become a client, to perform our agreement. The legal bases are your consent and the steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(a) and (b) GDPR). You are not legally required to provide your details, but without them we cannot answer your request.

sections.h: Where it is stored and who receives it
sections.p: Form submissions are sent by e-mail to our team and kept on our web server, which is hosted by JetServer in Israel, a country recognised by the European Commission as providing an adequate level of data protection. Where we use additional tools, such as our customer-management system (for example Airtable) or our property-management system, they act as processors bound by data-processing agreements. We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising.

To protect our contact form from spam and abuse, we use Google reCAPTCHA v3, provided by Google Ireland Limited. It is loaded only when you click Send and evaluates technical information such as your IP address, browser details and interaction with the page. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in security (GDPR art. 6(1)(f)). Google may process this data in the United States under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework. Google's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.
Some processors may store data outside the European Economic Area. Where this happens, transfers rely on an adequacy decision or on appropriate safeguards such as the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
Enquiries that do not lead to an agreement are deleted within 24 months. Client data is kept for as long as required by our agreement and by Greek tax and accounting law.

We protect personal data with encrypted connections (HTTPS), access limited to authorised staff, storage outside the public part of the web server and agreements with our service providers. No system is completely secure; if a security incident affects your data, we will notify you and the competent authorities as the law requires.

We store only your cookie choice and accessibility preferences in your browser. Google Analytics cookies are set only if you click “Allow statistics”, and you can withdraw at any time. See our Cookie Policy for details.

You can request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability or object to processing, and withdraw consent at any time, by emailing support@sivanmanagment.com. We reply within one month. You may also complain to the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (www.dpa.gr).

If you are in Israel, the Protection of Privacy Law, 5741-1981, and its regulations also apply to the processing of your information. You have the right to review the information we hold about you and to ask for it to be corrected or deleted, by writing to support@sivanmanagment.com. You may also contact the Israeli Privacy Protection Authority (www.gov.il/en/departments/the_privacy_protection_authority).
We do not make decisions about you based solely on automated processing, and we do not create marketing profiles.
We do not send marketing e-mails, SMS or WhatsApp messages without your prior consent. You can withdraw consent at any time by replying “stop” or writing to us.
Our services are intended for adults. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 16.
We may update this policy. The date of the latest update appears at the top of this page; material changes will be highlighted on the website.
Without your consent this website sets no cookies and loads no tracking, advertising or social-media pixels. Fonts, images and videos are served from our own server.

sections.h: Spam protection on the contact form
sections.p: Nothing from Google is loaded while you browse or fill in the contact form. Only when you click Send do we load Google reCAPTCHA v3, which checks that the request does not come from a robot. At that moment Google may set or read a security cookie (_GRECAPTCHA) and similar data in your browser, and receives technical information such as your IP address and browser details. We rely on our legitimate interest in protecting the form from abuse; the form shows this notice next to the Send button. You can always contact us by e-mail, phone or WhatsApp instead.

sections.h: What we store in your browser
sections.p: sm-consent (local storage, 12 months): saved only if you click “Allow statistics”, to remember your choice. If you click “Decline”, your choice is kept only in session storage and is deleted when you close the browser — nothing is stored permanently. sm-a11y (session storage, until the browser is closed): your accessibility-menu settings, only if you use the menu.

If you click “Allow statistics”, we load Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4 (Google Ireland Limited) to measure visits and how pages are used. Google then sets cookies such as _ga and _ga_<ID> for up to 2 years. Google Analytics does not store IP addresses; data may be processed in the United States under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework. Advertising features are switched off (Google Consent Mode: advertising storage denied). The legal basis is your consent (GDPR art. 6(1)(a)). If you decline, none of this is loaded.

Like every web server, our hosting provider (JetServer, Israel) records technical access logs (IP address, browser type, page and time) for security. They are kept for a short period and are not used to identify you.

You can change or withdraw your choice at any time through the “Cookie settings” link at the bottom of every page, or by clearing this website's data in your browser. If you withdraw your consent, we delete the Google Analytics cookies on this website.
This website presents the services of Sivan Menahem Management. The information is general and does not constitute an offer, or legal, tax or investment advice.
Any estimates of rental performance are indicative. We do not guarantee income, occupancy or property values. Services are provided only under a signed written agreement.
Some images on this website are illustrative, including AI-generated images, and do not depict properties under our management unless stated.
Text, design and logos on this website belong to Sivan Menahem Management or their licensors. Third-party trademarks belong to their owners.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: Sivan Management is committed to making this website usable by everyone, including people with disabilities. This statement describes what we have done, what we are still working on and how to reach us.

sections.p: We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at level AA. This also covers Israeli Standard IS 5568 (based on WCAG 2.0 AA), required by the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities (Service Accessibility Adjustments) Regulations, 5773-2013, and the European standard EN 301 549.

Semantic page structure with clear headings; full keyboard navigation with a visible focus indicator and a “skip to content” link; an accessibility menu on every page (text size, high contrast, highlighted links, readable font, line spacing, large cursor, stop animations); background videos can be paused and stop automatically when “reduce motion” is enabled; text alternatives for meaningful images, while decorative images and videos are hidden from screen readers; colour contrast designed for level AA; a responsive layout that supports zoom up to 200%; form fields with labels, clear error messages and no time limits; and the correct language and reading direction on every page in all eight languages, including right-to-left Hebrew.

The website was checked on 18 November 2026 with automated testing (axe-core, WCAG 2.1 AA rules) on the main pages in English and Hebrew, together with manual keyboard and screen-reader-structure review. Issues found were corrected. We re-check after every significant change and at least once a year.

Background videos are silent and carry no information. The content-management area (/admin/), used only by our staff, is a third-party tool and is not covered by this statement. Some translations are still being reviewed by native speakers. If you find something that does not work for you, please tell us and we will fix it or provide the information in another way.
The website is designed for current versions of Chrome, Safari, Firefox and Edge on desktop and mobile devices, and for common screen readers.
Our office is at Plateia Eleftherias 2, Chania. For information about physical access before a visit, or to arrange a meeting at another location, please contact us.

If you encounter an accessibility barrier, please contact our accessibility coordinator. Tell us the page, what you were trying to do and the device or browser you used. We aim to reply within five business days.
